Settings left at their default are not stored in `site_settings`, and the setting may also name a category that was renamed or deleted. In those cases the result is empty and `PG::Result#[0]` raises IndexError, so the migration aborts on most installs. It never reaches the `category_id == 0` fallback. db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:22 - Migrated hosts are not normalized, so existing embeds stop working.. The old setting accepted entries like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`, and the old specs used exactly those. The migration inserts each line as-is through raw SQL, which skips the model's `before_validation` stripping. It also keeps any `\r` or surrounding whitespace. `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` against the bare `uri.host`, so these rows never match. After the upgrade, embedding and topic retrieval fail with 'invalid referer host' for those sites. Strip the scheme, path and whitespace, lowercase each entry, and skip blank lines before inserting.

Guard the callback with `return if host.blank?`. Adding `validates :host, presence: true` would also make the error explicit.

A value containing a single quote breaks the migration, and a crafted value runs arbitrary SQL. Escape the value with `ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote(h)` or use bound parameters.
